/usr/local/texlive/2025/texmf-dist/tex/g.findings: Each fixed wave state advances by one segment length, shifts by segment length, and draws an angle-to-minus-angle arc using start radius. Final only moves to the decorated child endpoint.
The width key installs a strict remaining-distance check to final: an exact segment executes, while an incomplete terminal segment does not. State geometry uses the current input tangent transform.
TikZ wraps the selected decoration in pre=lineto, main child, and post=lineto states and applies mirror before the local y shift.
